test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

I was given this book by my English teacher.

options.text: This book was given to me by my English teacher.
My English teacher gave me this book.
This book gave me my English teacher.
My English teacher was given this book by me.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The type of the sentence is declarative, and the tense of the given sentence is **past simple**.
 
• The **subject** of the given **passive** sentence is** "I"** and the **object **is **“my English teacher”**.
 
• The format of passive voice for past simple tense is: **Subject + was/were + V3 (past participle form of the verb) + by + Object.**
 
• The format of active voice for past simple tense is:** Subject (Objective case) + V2 (past simple form of the verb) + object (Subjective case).**
 
• **Example**: 
 
 
• "A beautiful landscape was painted by the artist." (Passive Voice)
 
• "The artist painted a beautiful landscape." (Active Voice) 
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is- *“My English teacher gave me this book.”***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 ("This book was given to me by my English teacher.") is actually the original passive form** provided in the question, not an active voice alternative.
 
• **Option 3 ("This book gave me my English teacher.") **changes the meaning entirely, suggesting the book provided the English teacher, which is illogical.
 
• **Option 4 ("My English teacher was given this book by me.")** reverses the roles of the giver and receiver, altering the original sentence's intended meaning.
